subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should OpenClaw land this focused fresh-session fallback for accepted non-transient gateway disconnects now, while leaving reattach-first/no-second-run recovery to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The patch fixes the same-session corruption path, but it intentionally preserves a user-visible fallback policy where the detached gateway run and local fallback can both execute and possibly both deliver.

options.title: Land focused mitigation now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect path and keep the reattach-first redesign as the linked follow-up issue.

options.title: Pause for reattach-first recovery
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide that accepted disconnects should wait on the authoritative gateway run before any local fallback.

options.title: Require docs before merge
options.body: Ask for a small CLI docs update for `gateway_connection_lost` metadata before landing the implementation.

recommendation.title: Land focused mitigation now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect path and keep the reattach-first redesign as the linked follow-up issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the agent CLI/gateway dispatch path and recent session-routing changes that the potential merge ref must preserve.
